commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP 1: baseline curl version =="
rpm -q curl
echo "== STEP 2: ensure dnf versionlock plugin installed =="
if ! rpm -q python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n dnf install -y python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock
else
  echo "already installed"
fi
echo "== STEP 3: add versionlock for curl =="
sudo -n dnf versionlock add curl
echo "== STEP 4: show versionlock list =="
sudo -n dnf versionlock list
echo "== STEP 5: verify curl still functional =="
curl --version | head -1
echo "== STEP 6: simulate update to confirm curl excluded =="
sudo -n dnf check-update curl || true
echo "DONE"
